data.name: Iman
data.gender_notes: Iman is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n); īmān means 'faith, belief'. Its root is أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n). A core Qur'anic concept. Iman is a Arabic name meaning “Faith; belief”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Iman expresses “Faith; belief”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n); īmān means 'faith, belief'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iman total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
